raw_response.study_b_sample_and_data: Two informal settlements in the southern Conservation Zone of Xochimilco municipality, Mexico City (Amplicación Tizilclipa and San José Obrero). Data collected in 2017 (semi-structured interviews with government officials) and 2018–2019 (community leaders and residents), comprising N = 27 key-informant semi-structured interviews (17 community/parada leaders, 5 local Alcaldía government officials/piperos, and 3 Mexico City government officials from SACMEX, CORENA and SEDEMA) plus N = 41 resident questionnaires (20 in San José Obrero and 21 in Amplicación Tizilclipa), coded in MAXQDA 2018.
